import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check the latest error in the newest error log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /var/log/areloria/error-*.log | tail -1")
latest_err = stdout.read().decode().split()[-1]
print("Latest error log:", latest_err)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -30 " + latest_err)
print("\n=== Latest Error Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
